events.name: Philadelphia Phillies at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Cristopher Sánchez earned his major league-leading 18th win Sunday, leading the Philadelphia Phillies to a 7-2 victory over the New York Mets.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sánchez earns 18th win to take over major league lead as the Phillies beat the Mets 7-2

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Pittsburgh Pirates

headlines.description: — Rafael Flores Jr. hit the go-ahead two-run home run in the eighth inning to help the Pittsburgh Pirates to a 4-3 win over the Kansas City Royals on Sunday and complete a series sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flores Jr. hits go-ahead, 2-run homer in 8th as Pirates rally for 4-3 win and series sweep of Royals

headlines.description: — Gavin Williams threw seven shutout innings, Jo Adell had an RBI infield single and the Cleveland Guardians beat the Athletics 1-0 Sunday to remain atop the AL Central.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gavin Williams dominates with 7 shutout frames as Guardians edge Athletics to stay atop AL Central

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Griffin Jax tossed five shutout innings and the Tampa Bay Rays crept closer to the AL East title with a 5-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Griffin Jax tosses 5 shutout innings as Rays near AL East title with a 5-1 victory over the Red Sox

headlines.description: — Pete Crow-Armstrong hit his 45th home run as the Chicago Cubs moved closer to clinching a postseason berth with a 9-1 victory over the Cincinnati Reds on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Crow-Armstrong hits 45th homer as Cubs beat Reds 9-1, edge closer to playoff berth

headlines.description: — Mike Yastrzemski hit a three-run homer during a four-run sixth inning and the Atlanta Braves clinched the NL East title for the seventh time in nine years with a 4-2 win over the Houston Astros on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yastrzemski hits a 3-run homer and the Braves clinch the NL East title with 4-2 win over the Astros

events.name: Detroit Tigers at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Sam Antonacci had a two-run double in a three-run fourth inning and the Chicago White Sox kept pace in the AL Central and eliminated the Detroit Tigers from playoff contention with a rain-soaked 8-1 victory Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: White Sox keep pace in the AL Central with a rain-soaked 8-1 win over the Tigers

events.name: Washington Nationals at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Iván Herrera hit a pair of home runs, and Leo Bernal also homered as the St. Louis Cardinals scored three runs in the eighth inning to come from behind and beat the Washington Nationals 5-3 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bernal, Herrera homer in eighth inning to help Cardinals beat Nationals 5-3

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Texas Rangers

headlines.description: — Toronto leadoff hitter Brett Bateman reached base and scored three times, twice knocked in by Nathan Lukes, and the Blue Jays beat the AL West-leading Texas Rangers 7-2 on Sunday to avoid a series sweep in the matchup of playoff hopefuls.
headlines.shortLinkText: Playoff hopeful Blue Jays avoid series sweep with 7-2 win over AL West-leading Texas

headlines.description: — Rookie Kade Anderson tossed seven shutout innings, Dominic Canzone drove in two runs, and the Seattle Mariners beat the Colorado Rockies 2-1 on Sunday to stave off elimination from playoff contention.
headlines.shortLinkText: Anderson tosses 7 shutout innings, Mariners beat Rockies 2-1 to avoid elimination

events.name: Minnesota Twins at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Alan Roden hit a three-run homer and drove in a career-high four runs, and Dean Kremer yielded one hit over six stellar innings in the Minnesota Twins ' 8-0 victory over the Los Angeles Angels on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Alan Roden's 3-run homer, Dean Kremer's stellar start send Twins past Angels 8-0

events.name: Miami Marlins at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: Jake Cronenworth hit a pair of two-run homers and drove in five runs for the San Diego Padres, who beat the Miami Marlins 7-3 on Sunday to move closer to clinching their third straight postseason berth.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cronenworth homers twice, Padres beat Marlins 7-3 to lower wild-card magic number to 2

events.name: New York Yankees at Arizona Diamondbacks

headlines.description: — Nolan Arenado hit his third grand slam of the season top help the Arizona Diamondbacks beat the New York Yankees 8-4 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arenado hits grand slam in the Diamondbacks' 8-4 victory over the Yankees

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Kiké Hernández hit a go-ahead RBI double in the seventh inning, Emmet Sheehan did not give up a run in 5 1/3 innings, and the Los Angeles Dodgers beat the San Francisco Giants 3-1 on Sunday to complete a three-game sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dodgers get better of Giants' bullpen in 3-1 win to sweep three-game series

headlines.description: — William Contreras homered, and the Milwaukee Brewers earned their franchise-record 98th victory by beating the Baltimore Orioles 3-0 on Sunday night to complete a three-game sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brewers set franchise record with 98th victory, beat Orioles 3-0 to complete sweep
